title: Early alphabetic writing in the ancient Near East: the ‘missing link’ from Tel Lachish

passages.locator: pp. 711–714, especially Fig. 7 and first-line reading
passages.note: Independent excavation of a later rim sherd with a readable eye-shaped consonant ʿayin. The authors compare it with Egyptian eye D4 and discuss other signs and plausible chronological differences.
